entities.name: Signs
entities.description: Signs are visual displays used for communication, advertising, or informational purposes within the city. They include billboards, storefront signs, and other signage that contribute to city aesthetics and commerce.

entities.name: Sign pollution
entities.description: Sign pollution refers to the visual clutter and environmental impact caused by excessive or poorly regulated signage, including billboards and large advertisements that can detract from city aesthetics and contribute to visual noise.

entities.name: Commercial real estate
entities.description: Commercial real estate involves properties used for business purposes, including retail, office, and industrial spaces. Signage plays a critical role in identifying and marketing these properties.

entities.name: Sign regulations
entities.description: Sign regulations are rules and ordinances established by the city to control the size, placement, and type of signage to ensure safety, aesthetics, and reduce sign pollution.

entities.name: Traffic
entities.description: Traffic encompasses the movement of vehicles and pedestrians within the city. Signage related to traffic includes road signs, signals, and other indicators that regulate and guide traffic flow.
